# Token Creators

## Token Launchpad

Creators can launch tokens using the Basis Token Factory with no coding required. Choose between Stable+ (up-only appreciation) or Floor+ (rising floor with a configurable stability dial from 0%–100%). Creators earn fees on token transaction volume — paid in USDC, not tokens.

### Creator Benefits

#### Multiple Revenue Streams

**DEX Fee Rewards:** Receive 20% of all trading fees generated by your token in perpetuity. For Stable+ tokens (0.5% fee), this means 0.1% per trade. For Floor+ tokens (1.5% fee), this means 0.3% per trade. All paid in USDC.

**Loan Fee Sharing:** Earn a share of loan fees when your token is used as collateral.

**Early Access Advantage:** Purchase tokens during the bonding phase (up to the configured bonding phase target) to earn perpetual USDC rewards.

**Ethical Cash-Out Options:** Take profits via 100% LTV loans against your tokens without selling them or creating sell pressure.

#### Simple Token Creation

The three-step process:

**Step 1 — Metadata:** Token name, symbol, description, icon image, and optional social links (Telegram, X/Twitter, website).

**Step 2 — Tokenomics:**
* Starting liquidity ($100–$10,000 slider)
* Bonding phase USDC target ($100–$150,000)
* Token type: Stable+ or Floor+ (Floor+ shows a stability dial from 0%–100%)
* Optional: Freeze token (whitelist-only trading initially), Auto-vesting (cliff or gradual, configurable period)

**Step 3 — Review & Launch:** Summary page → single contract call → ~$0.14 BNB gas cost.

{% hint style="info" %}
**All tokens start at $1.00.** There is no custom initial price. Starting liquidity controls the depth of the liquidity pool, which determines price impact per trade.
{% endhint %}

#### Creator Controls (Dev Panel)

After launch, creators have access to:

* **Unfreeze:** Open public trading (one-way — cannot re-freeze)
* **Surge Tax:** Temporarily increase trading fees during hype cycles (7-day total quota)
* **Dev Tax Sharing:** Split your 20% creator fee across up to 10 wallets (1%–100% per wallet, displayed in basis points)
* **Whitelist Management:** Add wallet addresses with optional max buy limits during freeze phase
* **Token Info:** Name, symbol, type, supply, price, market cap, holders, frozen status

#### Web3 Brand Integration

**Crypto Community Exposure:** Introduce your brand to the growing Web3 ecosystem

**DeFi Participation:** Enter decentralized finance with minimal technical barriers

**ERC-20 Compatibility:** Works with standard Ethereum/BNB Chain infrastructure

**Token as Utility:** Enable Web3 transactions, governance, and loyalty programs

#### Fair, Transparent Launch

**Bonding Phase:** Auto-generates initial liquidity up to the configured USDC target. Early buyers earn permanent reward shares (3.33% of all future trading fees for that token).

**No Pre-Allocation:** Creators purchase tokens alongside the public — no insider advantage.

**Ethical Revenue Generation:** Earn through fees and loans without token dumps.

**100% Elastic Supply:** Minted on buy, burned on sell. No fixed supply, no hidden minting functions.
